implementation_plan: Implement a local mock provider that can return success, 429, timeout, 5xx, malformed output, and permanent auth failure.
Set a bounded concurrency and request rate; do not load-test a live third-party service.
Implement request deadlines, retryable-status allow-list, exponential backoff with jitter, and a circuit breaker/fallback where appropriate.
Track active work, queue lengths, successes/errors, retries, and latency; redact content and credentials from logs.
Assert all requests terminate within the limit and resources are released on cancellation.

reference_test_cases.input: Small bounded set of concurrent mock requests
reference_test_cases.expected: All successful mock responses return within configured timeout.
Retry follows policy and stops at bounded attempt/deadline.
No endless retries; client returns controlled error/fallback.

answer.review_gate: Do not publish until a reviewer inspects the actual submitted implementation/results and confirms the acceptance criteria; outline completion alone is not completion.

explanation: Reference solution outline for Production load and reliability test. It specifies a defensible implementation path, representative tests, and evaluation evidence. It is not a universally executable implementation: provider APIs, deployment environments, permissions, and available hardware vary. Use synthetic/test data, mock external services first, and keep credentials server-side. The exercise's current contains_all grader only checks required keywords and is a preliminary scaffold check, not a correctness/security evaluator; human review is required.
solution_quality_note: Design outline only; no solution implementation was run in this build.
